sv.title: Victor Nilsson Lindelöf njuter: ”Så mycket enklare”
sv.summary: Victor Nilsson Lindelöf förlängde nyligen kontraktet med Aston Villa. Den svenske lagkaptenen trivs. – Jag njuter av fotbollen, säger han.

en.title: Victor Nilsson Lindelöf enjoys it: "So much easier"
en.summary: Victor Nilsson Lindelöf recently extended his contract with Aston Villa. The Swedish team captain is happy. "I enjoy the football," he says.
